appUpdates.caption: Looks for newer versions of the apps on this PC and helps you finish each update from its original source.
appUpdates.coverageNote: Checks winget’s catalog, the Microsoft Store and the update feeds of apps that publish one. Updates install through their original source.
appUpdates.includeStoreCaption: Checks Store versions through winget, using this PC’s region. The Microsoft Store installs these updates.
appUpdates.includeOnlineCaption: Checks the update feeds of apps that publish one, such as many Electron apps. The app’s own updater installs the update.
appUpdates.storeHint: Opens the Microsoft Store, where this update is installed
appUpdates.packageMissing: winget is not installed, so apps cannot be updated from here yet.
win.appUpdates.includeWingetCaption: Checks every app winget recognizes, also ones it did not install. winget installs these updates here; some ask for administrator approval.
win.appUpdates.lastSource: At least one source stays on.
win.appUpdates.notificationsOff: Notifications are turned off for this app in Windows.
win.appUpdates.confirmPackagesFormat: winget will download and install the latest version of %d apps, one after another. By continuing you accept their license agreements.
win.appUpdates.confirmStoreNote: Microsoft Store apps open in the Store, which installs their updates.
win.appUpdates.idUnresolved: winget shortened this app’s id. Update it from the package manager.
